outcome: success of suture technique in stopping PPH
need for postoperative intensive care unit stay
cohort: 22 women who received Acar's uterine compressive atony sutures for postpartum hemorrhage due to uterine atony at a single tertiary hospital between January 2021 and November 2023.
finding: Acar's atony suture technique was successful in all cases, effectively stopping postpartum hemorrhage due to uterine atony and preventing hysterectomy.
